input: Prepare me for a meeting with Vercel (vercel.com)

challenges.evidence: Vercel's public Sandbox challenge generated 1,285 reports, paid $242,000 in bounties, and uncovered a Linux kernel zero-day that could leak host memory, crash the host, or execute code on it; Vercel said no report showed customer-data access.
challenges.challenge: Maintaining sandbox isolation and security as agents run hostile or untrusted code

challenges.evidence: Vercel said customers continued to give feedback that traffic bursts, viral launches, and misconfigured routes could create unexpected CDN bills, prompting Flat Rate CDN with fixed monthly pricing and no overages.
challenges.challenge: Customer concern about unpredictable CDN bills

challenges.evidence: The storage product brief explicitly calls out enterprise adoption blockers around scale, compliance, data locality, and encryption, alongside performance, availability, durability, speed, and cost trade-offs.
challenges.challenge: Supporting enterprise adoption requirements while broadening the platform

key_people.name: Guillermo Rauch
key_people.title: Founder and CEO
key_people.recent: Opened Ship 2026 with a vision of agentic infrastructure in which production context drives software improvement and agents can build, deploy, and operate software.

key_people.name: Malte Ubl
key_people.title: Chief Technology Officer
key_people.recent: At Ship 2026, announced Python generally available and Vercel Daemons for continuously running background workers.

key_people.name: Tomo Occhino
key_people.title: Chief Product Officer
key_people.recent: At Ship 2026, presented the Agent Stack and announced Vercel Drives, persistent workspaces for agents, plus updates to eve and Connect.

key_people.name: Jeanne DeWitt Grosser
key_people.title: Chief Operating Officer
key_people.recent: At Ship 2026, announced Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS generally available and enterprise-managed authorization for Vercel Connect in public beta.

key_people.name: Bereket Engida
key_people.title: Founder of Better Auth
key_people.recent: Joined Vercel with the Better Auth team after Vercel's acquisition, continuing open-source authentication and agent-identity work for Connect and eve.

priorities.evidence: At Ship 2026, Vercel framed its platform as infrastructure for building, deploying, and operating apps and agents, including agent-operated deployment and production automation.
priorities.priority: Build and commercialize agentic infrastructure for production workloads

priorities.evidence: Vercel announced Python generally available, containers for custom runtimes, and Daemons in public beta for continuously running background workers.
priorities.priority: Expand beyond frontend hosting into backend and long-running compute

priorities.evidence: A current Product Manager role owns Blob, Drives, and future database and key-value storage, with a mandate to integrate storage across Functions, backend services, Sandboxes, and Daemons and meet enterprise durability, compliance, locality, and encryption needs.
priorities.priority: Make persistent storage a core cloud primitive for apps and agents

priorities.evidence: Vercel launched a headless v0 API for programmatic app generation and highlighted AI Gateway production data showing open-weight models processed 71.5% of tokens and represented 23% of spend in the October index.
priorities.priority: Grow the AI application platform and model-access layer

priorities.evidence: Vercel made Connect generally available with short-lived scoped tokens, and its Ship announcements added enterprise-managed authorization and controls such as token budgets, US-only inference, and zero data retention.
priorities.priority: Provide secure, governed agent access to external systems

what_they_do.value: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next.

recent_changes.summary: Vercel Agent can investigate incidents, answer infrastructure questions, review pull requests, and propose approved changes from Slack for Pro and Enterprise teams.
recent_changes.headline: Vercel for Slack entered public beta

recent_changes.summary: Connect replaces long-lived provider tokens with short-lived, scoped runtime credentials for agents and supports 100+ services.
recent_changes.headline: Vercel Connect became generally available

recent_changes.summary: Vercel introduced fixed monthly CDN tiers, spike protection, and no overages in response to customer feedback about bill unpredictability.
recent_changes.headline: Flat Rate CDN launched for Pro teams

recent_changes.summary: Announcements included generally available Python and Vercel Drives, public-beta Daemons, AI Gateway governance controls, and Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS generally available.
recent_changes.headline: Vercel Ship 2026 expanded the platform for agents and backends

recent_changes.summary: Vercel and Shopify introduced an open-source Next.js storefront template with agent-readable product information and shopping tools.
recent_changes.headline: Vercel Shop with Shopify became generally available

talking_points: Which workloads are you prioritizing first as Vercel expands from frontend deployments into Python, containers, Daemons, and persistent storage—and where are the biggest reliability or cost trade-offs?
How are you balancing rapid agent adoption with the sandbox-security, scoped-authorization, data-locality, and encryption requirements that enterprise customers need?
Now that Flat Rate CDN, AI Gateway governance, and BYOC on AWS are available, which pricing, governance, or deployment-control gaps still slow enterprise expansion?
